comparison_contract: Every producer pipelines four durable append tickets through the public GroupCommitWriter API and retains stable affinity to one of eight worker lanes. Each group stages transaction-scoped WAL payloads and a Prepared state, then acknowledges only after one immutable write-epoch pending commit is created; no mutable collection frontier is read or written and transaction-state root authorization is deferred to drain/checkpoint. Live Prepared state protects pre-ack payloads from GC and expires from object-store last_modified using a store-clock probe. Per-operation latency runs from submission through durable receipt and excludes checkpoint drain. After all producers join, GroupCommitWriter::drain barriers every lane, records drain_ms separately, refreshes one lane over the globally acknowledged pending set, root-authorizes and materializes the captured commits, verifies every run against the published per-modality consumed fence, retires pending objects, and rebuilds an existing immutable global search artifact over the materialized delta before reopen/read measurement. This prevents the stable base and delta from each consuming the full query segment budget. The process-shared last-write-wins allocator CAS-reserves disjoint 4096-generation ranges only when stale or exhausted. Every cell uses the same source archive, instance type, dimensions, group bounds, raw-sample schema, full inserted-vector point-visibility check, explicit drain telemetry, and reconciled aggregate plus per-query read-path request/byte/segment telemetry. Twenty preregistered inserted vectors provide known exact top-1 ground truth and are queried through production SrhtPqScan with max_segments=4 and max_candidates_per_segment=8; every query must return its exact ID with recall@1 1.0 and read p95 below 200 ms. A writer-count/repetition cohort is identical across paired 2K and 16K cell counts and distinct from other writer counts. Cell count and concurrent producer count are the only matrix factors. Each completed cell must have write p95 below 200 ms and throughput at least 5 records/s per configured writer (5, 40, and 160 records/s); a miss writes gate-specific markers and terminates before later cells. The 2K index and matrix complete before constructing the 16K index. Five repetitions are mandatory; incomplete CSV files are never eligible for inspection.
